A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the DAMA/NAI and DAMA-LIBRA results have provided the first and so far the only model independent evidence for the existence of Dark Matter particles in nature, with a high statistical significance, by exploiting the annual modulation signature.
, at the present status, there is a model independent positive evidence for the presence of Dark Matter particles in the gallic halo.
, at the present stage, the model independent evidence of a signal is supported by a large body of experimental information.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the DAMA results are in agreement with the standard model, with the galactic halo model and with the standard cosmological model, while the other results are in disagreement with the standard cosmology.

, in spite of the large number of different experimental efforts, the model independent positive results from the DAMA experiment are still the only evidence of a dark matter particle annual modulation signature.
